India and Russia Discuss Expanding Defense Ties Beyond Arms Sales

India and Russia are exploring ways to deepen their defense relationship beyond traditional arms sales, aiming for a more technology-driven industrial partnership. Discussions include potential joint production of defense equipment, with missile exports and fighter jet offers being early areas of focus. The Indian Army chief undertook a three-day visit to Moscow, during which discussions reportedly covered spare parts, air defense systems, and future tank technologies. This engagement occurs as India also strengthens its cybersecurity, critical technology, and supply chain cooperation with Australia.
